title: Persona 5 Tactica
description: Persona 5 Tactica is a turn-based tactical RPG starring the Phantom Thieves. After the group is pulled into a strange realm ruled by oppressive Legionnaires, revolutionary Erina offers an alliance. Battles combine cover, positioning, ranged attacks, Persona skills, knockdowns and Triple Threat attacks in compact tactical arenas.

description_short: A stylish turn-based tactical RPG that sends the Phantom Thieves into a revolutionary conflict in a strange occupied realm.
description_ar: لعبة تقمص أدوار تكتيكية بنظام أدوار من عالم Persona 5. ينتقل اللصوص الأشباح إلى عالم غريب تسيطر عليه قوات Legionnaires، ويتحالفون مع الثورية Erina. يعتمد القتال على التموضع والغطاء والأسلحة والـPersona والهجمات الجماعية التكتيكية.

worldSummary: The Phantom Thieves are transported into a realm shaped by authoritarian rule and revolution. Erina becomes their guide and ally as they move between Kingdoms, confront rulers and uncover the truth behind the world and Toshiro Kasukabe’s connection to it.

storyChapters.title: A Strange Kingdom
storyChapters.body: The Phantom Thieves are pulled into an unfamiliar realm ruled by Legionnaires.

storyChapters.title: Erina’s Revolution
storyChapters.body: A revolutionary named Erina rescues the group and asks them to help overthrow oppression.

storyChapters.title: Toshiro’s Connection
storyChapters.body: Diet member Toshiro Kasukabe becomes central to the mystery behind the Kingdoms and their rulers.

storyChapters.title: Repaint Your Heart
storyChapters.body: The DLC challenge storyline adds additional tactical scenarios and returning Persona 5 characters.

faq.q: Does Persona 5 Tactica work on Nintendo Switch 2?
faq.a: Yes through backward compatibility where Nintendo marks the Nintendo Switch release as supported. This file does not classify it as a native Nintendo Switch 2 Edition.

faq.q: What language is the supplier version of Persona 5 Tactica?
faq.a: Supplier listing language supplied by the user: Simplified Chinese. Official/regional language details are preserved separately in supported_languages_raw and nintendo_notes so the supplier SKU is not generalized to every region.
The main game is single-player; no multiplayer mode is asserted in this file.

faq.q: Why are some Switch 2 performance resolution fields blank for Persona 5 Tactica?
faq.a: Because exact measured Switch 2 backward-compatibility rendering values were not verified. The template is intentionally left blank rather than filled with hardware maximums or guesses.

verdictSummary: A focused, stylish tactical spin-off that adapts Persona 5’s identity to compact strategy battles. It is strongest for players who want more Phantom Thieves and turn-based tactics rather than the social-calendar structure of the mainline RPG.
